lessons.text: When a check says a filter applies per database (or per scope), give the fixture the same entity in two scopes and assert the other scope is unaffected, and pick names that cannot appear as substrings of other fields.

lessons.key: gate_fail::put a component s display and lock decisions inside the child that renders them and pass raw parent state as props so a mount test exercises the decision instead of a value hard coded in the test
lessons.text: Put a component's display and lock decisions inside the child that renders them and pass raw parent state as props, so a mount test exercises the decision instead of a value hard-coded in the test.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for a display rule combining several guards default locked loaded has match give each guard a fixture where only that guard decides the outcome including the no match variant of every state
lessons.text: For a display rule combining several guards (default, locked, loaded, has-match), give each guard a fixture where only that guard decides the outcome, including the no-match variant of every state.
